d: Part of the garden, to which corresponds the apartment of Donna Anna with ajar door. Pasqualello wrapped in his hood, walking, then Don Giovanni, and Donna Anna, who holds him grabbed by the cloak.
The Commendatore, and Don Giovanni, who unleashes the sword, Pasqualello in the background.
The Duke Ottavio, and Donna Anna preceded by Servi with torches.
The Duke alone.
Countryside with rustic houses, and noble casino, outside the walls of Villena. Don Giovanni and Pasqualeello.
Donna Elvira with two servants, Don Giovanni and Pasqualello on the side, who then advance.
Donna Elvira, and Pasqualello.
Donna Elvira alone.
Don Giovanni, and Donna Ximena, from the mess.
Donna Ximena.
Maturina, Biagio, and Villani, who play the naccheras, then Pasqualeello.
Don Giovanni, Maturina, Biagio, and Pasqualello.
Maturina, Don Giovanni, and Pasqualello.
Don Giovanni, and Maturina.
Pasqualello, then Donna Ximena, then Don Giovanni.
Donna Elvira, and sayings.
Donna Elvira, and Don Giovanni, then Maturina.
Donna Elvira, and Maturina.

Remote place surrounded by cypresses, where in the middle stands a dome supported by columns with burial urn, above which equestrian statue of the Commendatore. The Duke Ottavio with paper in his hand, and an Engraver.
Don Giovanni, and Pasqualello.
Room of Don Giovanni. Lantern, setting the table, then Donna Elvira.
Don Giovanni, and Donna Elvira.
Don Giovanni, Pasqualello, and Lanterna.
The Commander, and sayings.
Lanterna, Maturina, Donna Elvira, Donna Ximena, Duke Ottavio and Pasqualiello.
